item.title: ARC RAIDERS: Yes, There Is A New Bug That Gives You Infinite Health
item.description: A new infinite health exploit has appeared in Arc Raiders that lets players dupe healing items for god-mode invincibility, emerging just after Embark's February 11th hotfix for dupes and infinite ammo.

item.title: Former ASHES OF CREATIONS Developers File Lawsuits Against Intrepid Studios Over Unpaid Wages And More
item.description: Three ex-Intrepid Studios employees filed separate class-action lawsuits, accusing the Ashes of Creation studio of mass layoffs without the legally required 60-day notice, plus failure to pay final wages.

item.title: JOHN WICK Video Game From Saber Interactive Starring Keanu Reeves In The Works; First Trailer Released
item.description: A single-player third-person John Wick video game is in the works from Saber Interactive and Lionsgate, with star Keanu Reeves set to return as the titular assassin...

item.title: MARVEL TOKON: FIGHTING SOULS Locks In Launch Window, Reveals Magik, Danger And Wolverine
item.description: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls has confirmed the official release date of the game during Sony's State of Play and revealed the Unbreakable X-Men team: Storm, Wolverine, Magik, and Danger.

item.title: DEAD BY DAYLIGHT Movie Adaptation Lands Two Major Horror Talents To Write The Script
item.description: David Leslie Johnston-McGoldrick and Alexandre Aja have been tapped to write the script for Blumhouse and Atomnic Monster's movie adaptation of Dead by Daylight, Behaviour Interactive's hit horror game.

item.title: STAR WARS: GALACTIC RACER Gameplay Trailer Showcases High-Stakes, High-Octane Outer Rim Racing
item.description: A new gameplay trailer for Star Wars: Galactic Racer shows off the upcoming runs-based racing game set in the lawless Outer Rim of the galaxy.

item.title: FORTNITE Confirms SOLO LEVELING Collaboration Will Kick Off This Week
item.description: Fortnite is kicking off a new collaboration with Solo Leveling: Arise that will see cosmetics based on the anime-inspired PC/mobile game available in Epic's battle royale.

item.title: TOMB RAIDER Set Photos: Sophie Turner's Lara Croft Battles The Rain, Joined By Martin Bobb-Semple's Zip
item.description: A new batch of set photos and videos from Prime Video's Tomb Raider show Sophie Turner's Lara Croft battling the elements, and joined by the fan-favorite Zip (played by Martin Bobb-Semple).

item.title: Long-Awaited BIOSHOCK Movie Gets Promising Update From Producer
item.description: Producer Roy Lee has hinted that work may soon begin on the long-awaited BioShock movie, which was first announced by Netflix in 2022.

item.title: HIGHGUARD Confirms Content Update This Week Amid Layoffs And Sinking Player Numbers
item.description: Wildlight Entertainment announced a new Highguard patch dropping later this week, adding the Cloudreach airship base, and new store items despite recent mass layoffs and a 98% Steam player count drop.
